title: Reconstructed Chromatic Obstruction and Nuclear Repair Annihilation

hopkins_smith_1998.name: Smash Product Theorem
hopkins_smith_1998.statement: Chromatic localization L_{E(n)} is smashing: L_{E(n)} X \simeq X \wedge L_{E(n)} S^0.

morava_k_theory.name: Monochromatic K(n)-Localization
morava_k_theory.statement: Morava K-theory localization L_{K(n)} is non-smashing; does not commute with arbitrary products.

bhls_2023.name: Disproof of the Telescope Conjecture (Burklund-Hahn-Levy-Schlank)
bhls_2023.statement: For prime p=2 and height n=2, the canonical comparison map L_{T(n)} S^0 -> L_{K(n)} S^0 is NOT an equivalence. The telescope conjecture fails.

checks: BHLS 2023 correctly identified as L_{T(n)} != L_{K(n)} for n >= 2

derivation_steps.statement: By BHLS (2023), for n >= 2, L_{T(n)} S^0 -> L_{K(n)} S^0 is not an equivalence; the fiber F_n has non-zero homotopy classes.
In SolidMod_R, the unrestricted product prod_{k=1}^infty Z_p admits non-trivial phantom maps and lim^1 discrepancies into F_n.
derivation_steps.justification: Milnor lim^1 sequence on unfiltered profinite products.

derivation_steps.statement: The resulting class [\xi_{T4R}] in Ext^1_{SolidMod_R}(prod Z_p, F_n) is strictly non-zero, formally establishing Omega_{T4R} != 0.
derivation_steps.justification: Non-triviality of the BHLS chromatic boundary class.

annihilation_record.repair_functor: rho_{T2} (Nuclear trace-class completion / Nuclear Mittag-Leffler tower)

derivation_steps.statement: The unrestricted chromatic obstruction Omega_{T4R} lives in Ext^1(prod Z_p, F_n) != 0.
derivation_steps.justification: Derived projective limit discrepancy on unfiltered profinite products.

derivation_steps.statement: Application of the nuclear repair rho_{T2} factors the coefficient module through a Nuclear Mittag-Leffler tower {M_k, f_k}.
derivation_steps.justification: Definition of nuclear solid module category Nuc(R).

derivation_steps.statement: By Target T2, R^1 \varprojlim M_k = 0 and phantom maps vanish identically (Phan = 0).
derivation_steps.justification: Gate T2.3 Derived Projective Limit Theorem.

derivation_steps.statement: The derived obstruction class collapses: Ext^1_{Nuc(R)}(rho_{T2}(prod Z_p), F_n) = 0, yielding Omega(rho(X)) = 0.
derivation_steps.justification: Exactness of nuclear projective limits and Milnor sequence trivialization.
